The '''''Portrait of Axkva Min''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] depicting the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]], [[Axkva Min]]. The [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Dageerin]] had a copy of this painting in his possession, and later sold it to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent who managed to seal her again after gaining her necklace.

==Behind the scenes==
The Portrait of Axkva Min appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. The player could buy this painting from Dageerin for 1 Axkva Min Token of Heroism after having completed the Heroic instance.
